name: llama.cpp issue #27097: Vulkan slow token generation with AMD dGPU Resizable BAR disabled
notes: RX 7900 XTX with ReBAR off in BIOS: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_XL decode 13.89 t/s at n=128 and 25.28 t/s at d=4096; setting GGML_VK_DISABLE_HOST_VISIBLE_VIDMEM=1 raises these to 37.09 and higher. A commenter measured 40 -> ~6 t/s on the same card. A patch that auto-detects a small host-visible VRAM heap is linked (craig-b/llama.cpp 6c1281da3). Issue open, labelled bug-unconfirmed.
